idea-plugin.name: yof
idea-plugin.description:
Leaked keys and made-up packages, marked in the editor when you save, each with a plain explanation and a prompt to paste into the AI assistant that wrote the code. Runs the open-source yof CLI on your machine: rules only, no account, no telemetry, and no network call unless you turn on package lookups.

yof attack (Tools menu) tests your own running app with your own test accounts, in the background, after you confirm.

action.description: Run yof check on the project now
Run yof attack against the address in Settings, in the background
